Eugenus, Inc. is seeking an experienced, highly motivated **Senior Buyer** to support the procurement and strategic sourcing of materials, components, equipment, and services for our next-generation semiconductor capital equipment products.

The Senior Buyer will manage assigned suppliers and commodities throughout the procurement lifecycle, from sourcing and supplier selection through negotiation, purchase order execution, delivery, and supplier performance management. This position will play an important role in ensuring material availability, controlling costs, reducing supply-chain risk, and supporting both New Product Introduction (NPI) and production requirements.

The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Planning, Finance, Program Management, and global procurement teams to ensure suppliers meet Eugenus requirements for **quality, cost, delivery, technology, and responsiveness**.

* Track and report measurable procurement results, including cost savings, purchase price variance, supplier performance, shortages, and other assigned KPIs.

new_jobs.title: Procurement Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Art F/X

Art F/X Screen Printing & Embroidery is a family-owned, Nebraska-based company that has proudly served our customers for more than 33 years. We specialize in screen printing and embroidery, with additional promotional products and services that help businesses, organizations, schools, teams, and communities bring their brands to life.

Our success is built on strong customer relationships, quality workmanship, reliable service, and a team-oriented culture. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a **Procurement Analyst** who will play an important role in ensuring we purchase the right products, at the right cost, at the right time, and with the quality our customers expect.

Position Summary

The Procurement Analyst is responsible for supporting and improving Art F/X's purchasing and procurement processes. This position will work closely with internal departments, vendors, suppliers, shipping/receiving, and leadership to ensure goods are purchased efficiently, arrive when needed, meet quality expectations, and are accurately received and accounted for.

This role combines **purchasing, vendor management, logistics coordination, cost analysis, problem-solving, and transaction management**. The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, proactive, and comfortable following an issue from the initial purchase order through delivery and final resolution.

The Procurement Analyst will be expected to continually look for opportunities to **reduce costs, improve purchasing efficiency, minimize delays, strengthen vendor relationships, and prevent recurring purchasing or product issues.**

Key ResponsibilitiesPurchasing & Procurement

* Purchase blank apparel, supplies, materials, and other goods based on company needs, inventory levels, customer orders, and production requirements.
* Review purchasing needs and determine appropriate quantities, timing, vendors, and shipping methods.
* Create, maintain, and manage purchase orders and purchasing transactions.
* Verify pricing, quantities, availability, lead times, freight costs, and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate purchases with internal departments to ensure purchasing decisions align with production schedules and customer commitments.
* Monitor open purchase orders and follow up on outstanding or delayed orders.
* Help establish purchasing practices that balance inventory availability with responsible cash flow and inventory levels.

Cost Management & Analysis

* Analyze vendor pricing, freight costs, minimum order quantities, discounts, and other purchasing factors.
* Identify opportunities to reduce the total cost of goods purchased.
* Compare vendors and purchasing options while considering price, quality, availability, freight, service, and reliability.
* Monitor purchasing trends and identify areas where Art F/X can improve margins or reduce unnecessary expenses.
* Support negotiations with vendors when appropriate.
* Maintain accurate purchasing information to help leadership make informed procurement decisions.

Logistics & Delivery Coordination

* Track purchased goods from order placement through delivery.
* Communicate with vendors regarding order confirmations, backorders, substitutions, shipping delays, and changes in availability.
* Coordinate with Shipping & Receiving and other internal departments to ensure expected deliveries are known and properly received.
* Identify potential delivery issues early and communicate them to the appropriate team members.
* Assist in developing solutions when goods are delayed, unavailable, damaged, or incorrectly shipped.
* Help prioritize urgent purchasing needs when customer or production deadlines require immediate attention.

Vendor & Product Issue Resolution

* Investigate defective, damaged, incorrect, or otherwise unacceptable goods.
* Process returns, credits, replacements, refunds, and other vendor transactions related to purchasing issues.
* Communicate professionally with vendors to resolve issues in a timely manner.
* Document purchasing and product issues and track them through resolution.
* Identify recurring product or vendor problems and communicate trends to leadership.
* Help hold vendors accountable to agreed-upon pricing, quality, service, and delivery expectations.

Internal Collaboration

* Work closely with Production, Sales, Sales Support, Shipping & Receiving, Accounting, and company leadership.
* Communicate purchasing status and potential concerns before they become larger problems.
* Help internal teams understand product availability, lead times, purchasing constraints, and potential alternatives.
* Collaborate with departments to find practical solutions when purchasing or supply challenges arise.
* Support a culture of accountability, communication, and teamwork.

Systems & Reporting

* Maintain accurate purchasing records and information within company systems.
* Review purchasing data and prepare reports related to spending, vendors, costs, backorders, delivery performance, and purchasing trends.
* Monitor open purchase orders and outstanding vendor commitments.
* Ensure purchasing transactions are accurately documented and completed.
* Assist with developing and improving procurement procedures and reporting tools.

Why Art F/X?

At Art F/X, you aren't simply filling a position. You are joining a **family-owned company with more than three decades of history** and an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how we operate and grow.

The Procurement Analyst will have the opportunity to work across the organization and directly influence **costs, efficiency, production, vendor relationships, and customer satisfaction**.

We value people who take ownership, communicate well, solve problems, and want to help make the company better.

**If you are someone who enjoys finding a better way, managing details, solving problems, and making an impact on the bottom line, we'd like to hear from you.**

Pay: $18.50 - $25.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)

Homes of America, LLC (“HOA”), which was formed in 2020, is a nationwide owner and operator of manufactured housing communities. The firm is focused on opportunistically acquiring, improving, and operating manufactured housing communities in primary, secondary, and tertiary markets across the United States. **Utility Analysis & Cost Recovery**

* Analyze utility consumption, billing, expenses, revenue, and resident recapture across the portfolio.

* Review vendor, contractor, and engineering proposals, invoices, reports, and deliverables for accuracy and completeness.

**Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Support**

* Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased utility recapture.
* Develop business cases and financial analysis for proposed utility initiatives.
* Help establish consistent processes and controls for utility billing, data collection, reconciliation, and project execution.
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Property Management, IT, Accounts Payable, and other departments on cross-functional initiatives.
* Support implementation of new systems, technologies, vendors, and operational processes.

**Reporting & Communication**

* Prepare recurring and ad hoc management reports, analyses, and professional PowerPoint presentations.
* Present findings, project updates, trends, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and management.
* Translate complex financial, operational, and utility information into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Effectively communicate with engineers, vendors, contractors, property managers, field personnel, and senior stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.

* Ability to effectively use AI tools to support analysis, research, reporting, process improvement, and productivity.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work with large datasets, manage multiple priorities and projects, and collaborate across departments.
* Strong PowerPoint skills and ability to present information clearly and professionally.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with water/wastewater utilities, infrastructure, submetering, resident utility billing, or utility cost recovery.
* Experience with manufactured housing, multifamily housing, or property management.
* Knowledge of water meters, distribution systems, wells, pumps, sewer systems, lift stations, or related infrastructure.
* Experience coordinating engineers, contractors, vendors, or infrastructure projects.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will help the organization:

* Increase utility cost recovery and reduce revenue leakage.
* Improve utility data accuracy, reporting, and visibility.
* Identify and resolve billing, consumption, metering, and infrastructure issues.
* Effectively coordinate utility and infrastructure projects.
* Improve accountability among engineers, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.
* Reduce manual work through improved processes, AI, and automation.
* Deliver measurable financial and operational results and clear, data-driven recommendations.

\*\*Salary to commensurate with experience.

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home
